subject: general
question: Which of the following metals is most metallic in nature?
solution:
The correct answer is Cs 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cesium (Cs), **the final naturally occurring** alkali metal,** possesses the most incredible** metallic properties.**
 
• **Alkali metals, alkaline earth metals, and transition metals** all contain metallic elements**.**
 
• **Metal-containing elements are said to have a metallic quality.**
 
• Most **metals have high melting and boiling temperatures,** are **malleable and ductile, and are hard.**
 
• **Cesium (Cs) is the most metallic naturally occurring element, while Francium (Fr) is the most metallic and radioactive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-metallic elements**

 
 
• **Non-metallic elements are those that exhibit non-metallic properties.**
 
• Typically, their **melting and boiling points are low.**
 
• Non-metals are often poor conductors of both electricity and heat.
 
• The **periodic table's least metallic element is Fluorine (F).**
